name: Brotherly Love
label: Quest
description: Brotherly Love: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: He must be put out of his misery, soldier! He knows not what he does. He has become a mindless servant of the dreaded Banshee Queen.
Venture forth, across the Field of Strife, to the depths of Frostwolf territory. Find my brother and destroy him. His torment must come to an end.

clips.title: Progress
paras: It is with heavy heart that I give such an order, soldier.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You did remember to burn the corpse, didn't you?
